::: {#lem-no-candidate .lemma name="The candidate parameter set is empty" date="2026-10-11" export="lem-no-candidate"}
The set defined in @def-candidate is empty.
:::

::: {.proof of="lem-no-candidate"}
Use all definitions, notation, and hypotheses in the exact statement of @def-candidate. If such data existed, @lem-small would give $h>3/8$. If $h\ge4$, this would contradict @lem-high. If $3/8<h<4$, @lem-middle-spectral-closure gives contradictory strict upper and lower spectral bounds at the same energy. Equivalently, @lem-robin maps the data into $\mathcal D$ of @def-analytic and gives $\mathcal G<0$, whereas @lem-terminal gives $\mathcal G>0$. This contradiction exhausts all heights.
:::
